## Change

Summarize the change and link the issue or requirement.

## Verification

- [ ] List the local and CI checks, commands and results.
- [ ] Cover applicable failure, authorization, and compatibility cases.
- [ ] Include affected journeys and accessibility evidence for browser changes.

## Contracts and operations

- [ ] Update affected API, data, UX, or operational documentation.
- [ ] Include fresh and upgrade migration evidence and recovery steps when applicable.
- [ ] Review applicable secrets, permissions, provider effects, and logs.
- [ ] Record applicable rollout gates, deployment dependencies, and held capabilities.

Use N/A with a reason for items outside the scope. Include only synthetic or sanitized evidence.
